responsibility: This definition module is a placeholder for the Logitech-compatible DebugTrace module in GNU Modula-2. It defines no public API beyond the module itself and serves as a compatibility import target for legacy code that expects the module to exist.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the DebugTrace same-name pair: it declares only the existence of module DebugTrace and no exported API, whereas DebugTrace.mod is the corresponding implementation stub.
